subject: Priority matrix + validation plan for ClearWave - next tests & timeline
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Collins <hannah@clearwavehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-20T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Priority matrix + validation plan for ClearWave - next tests & timeline

Hi Hannah — thanks again for the demo today. Quick recap from our side and a proposal for the next week to keep momentum.

Key pains you reiterated:
- Latency spikes on 99th pct during peak ingestion windows (impacting clinician workflows)
- Unpredictable per-token costs when downstream cache hit rates are low
- Requirements for traceable audit logs and KV retention policy for 90+ days

Primary goals you shared:
1) Reduce 99th pct generation latency to <400ms for typical clinical prompts
2) Demonstrate steady-state per-token cost below $0.0006 with caching/quantization enabled
3) Verify audit log fidelity with sample patient-masked transactions for compliance team sign-off

Decision criteria we agreed to feed into the priority matrix:
- Latency at P50/P95/P99 (prod-like load)
- Effective per-token cost (including cache hit adjustments)
- Integration effort (estimated engineering days)
- Audit/logging completeness (fields retained, redaction ease)
- Rollout risk (fallback behavior, model variant compatibility)

Attached is a first-pass priority matrix (Priority_Matrix_v1.xlsx) with suggested weightings, and a small validation kit (Validation_Kit_ClearWave_v1.zip) containing: a lightweight test harness, prompts, and a short script to synthesize load. I also included LightWeight_Test_Instructions.pdf with step-by-step run instructions.

Proposed next tests (week of Jun 21):
- Test A: 15-min steady stream at 2x baseline request rate to capture P99 behavior (we run on Redwood Dedicated equivalent)
- Test B: Cache-enabled vs cache-disabled comparison with identical prompt mix (measure effective token cost)
- Test C: Audit log ingestion and redaction check with sample masked events

Asks / timeline:
- Can your infra lead run Test C in a sandbox by Thu 6/24? (procurement/sysadmin access may be needed)
- Can we schedule a 30-min call Wed 6/23 to review matrix weighting and confirm acceptance criteria?

If that works I’ll provision the validation kit and spin up the Dedicated test env.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Aditya — really clear summary, thank you. A few quick notes from our side:
- We can run Test C in our staging cluster but will need the instructions simplified for our compliance team (they prefer a single script entrypoint).
- Procurement asked me to loop them in early; they want an estimated SOW and line-item for dedicated capacity if we proceed.
- For the cache test, can you include example input/output sizes so our finance lead can estimate cost correlation?

Wed 6/23 11:00 PT works for a short sync — I’ll put it on the calendar and invite our infra lead (Samira). Procurement (procurement@clearwavehealth.com) will be on the call as an observer.

One more ask: can you add a simple competitor column to the matrix that reflects expected performance vs the incumbent? We need that to justify the business case internally.

Best,
Hannah Collins
Head of Clinical Ops | ClearWave Health

I’ll join Wed 6/23 11:00 PT and can present the matrix; Aditya, can you prepare a 5-slide one-pager that summarizes the results we expect to see from each test?

—Marissa
